exceptions.native-targets: The release carries the GPU builds: aarch64-apple-darwin with Metal, and x86_64- and aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu with Vulkan, built by release-build-local.yml. No musl: the Vulkan backend loads the system's Vulkan driver through libvulkan.so.1, which a static musl binary cannot do. No Windows: the program uses Unix interfaces (statvfs, termios, Unix permission bits). No illumos and no x86_64 macOS: ruled out by the owner. HIP and CUDA are built from source.
